title: Lone working and staff safety
summary: How carers are kept safe and supported when they work alone in people’s homes and travel between visits.
whenToUse: Every year, after a staff safety incident, or when visits are added in the evening or at night.

statements.focus: Home environment risk assessments that cover risks to staff as well as the person.
Lone working procedures, check-ins and on-call cover that carers know and use.
Support after a difficult visit and how carers’ wellbeing is checked.
Managers available out of hours and how quickly they respond.
